stage_model.rank_cost_curve_note: Demonstration only; a rank 1 price of tier N+1 exceeds the rank 99 price of tier N. No current XP/price balancing promised.
stage_model.sp_currency: Tyz's Skills Skill Points earned via its own leveling XP; not vanilla XP
stage_model.native_upper_limit: UNKNOWN; do not sell ranks that would be capped or provide no additional effect. Later Strength stages intentionally disabled in prototype until runtime.

eligibility.native_monk_faction: single-use ability skills and license for leveled Monk abilities
eligibility.universal_tyz: Shared Pufferfish-style utility/attributes from Tyz owned ranks should also be available to non-Monks where appropriate
eligibility.stage_unlock: Tier N requires previous tier's ACTUAL SERVER level equal to 99; merely owning tier N-1 is insufficient
eligibility.purchase_guard: Tyz's Skills SkillActionEvent.PurchasePre for regular and bulk; cancel if tier or Monk license wrong or native benefit ineffective
eligibility.refund_guard: SkillActionEvent.RefundPre for regular and bulk; reject earlier-tier refunds while any later tier has rank > 0
eligibility.admin_bypass: Tyz's Skills ISkillManager.setSkillLevel does not fire PurchasePre; admin/direct API is trusted only or requires separate reconciliation; no naive client-only gate
eligibility.respec_policy: Preserve purchased universal ranks; Monk-only rank effects must be suspended safely if Monk identity/license removed, without deleting levels; this requires code bridge.

adaptation_rules: One canonical Tyz effect owner per shared attribute; disable/avoid duplicate Pufferfish or existing Tyz modifiers for the same purchase.
Finite bounded traits like Cooldown Reduction and Harvest Tier use only as many levels and tiers as actually useful; do not instantiate all five stages.
Original Monk one-time movement, Withering Stare, Catch Arrows, Creeper Kiss, etc remain native faction skills.
No creative flight unlock or Apotheosis Unbound in Monk/Tyz tiers; Draconic Curio supplies flight.
Mod-specific character resources require actual per-player hooks; Tyz custom JSON directly changes only registered player attributes.
Tyz source custom JSON requires 99 prices and 99 cumulative modifier values for each 99-rank stage; keep config files outside pack until boot/acceptance tests.
Validate SP gains and integer price sums, float modifier precision, native numeric caps, refunds, scale synchronization, multiplayer, death and login.
Monk Mastery XP remains separate from Tyz SP pending explicit balance/economy integration. No vanilla XP charge.
stage_effective_cap_note: Illustrative Strength V is almost certainly beyond a realistic vanilla attack damage attribute cap. It does NOT authorize live installation as configured. Per-trait generated tiers must truncate to native effective maximum, plus actual gameplay and physics safety.
